description: This PHP class implements an SVG icon extractor plugin for Drupal, handling local SVG files, extracting SVG content and attributes, and discovering icons from specified sources.

classes.name: SvgExtractor
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class for extracting SVG icons from local files, including methods for discovering icons, loading icon data, and extracting SVG content and attributes.

methods.name: discoverIcons
methods.description: Discovers SVG icons from configured sources, filtering out remote sources, and returns an array of icon definitions with paths and metadata.

methods.name: loadIcon
methods.description: Loads an icon based on provided icon data, extracting SVG content and creating an icon definition.

methods.name: extractSvg
methods.description: Extracts SVG content and attributes from a local SVG file, excluding the parent <svg> tag, and returns content and attribute data.
